name: Gargantuan War Machine
descr: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.

features.name: Relentless
features.text: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Awesome Size
features.text: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark **1d4** Stress.

features.name: Rocket Punch
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes **4d12+10** direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining their benefits.

features.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
features.text: **Spend a Fear** to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take **4d12** direct physical damage and are _Vulnerable_ until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Supercharged
features.text: _Countdown (Loop 2d6)_. When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine's chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra **1d12** damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.
